warning: These are planned tests, not executed application validation.

cases.title: Adult verification
cases.method: Create unverified adult, attempt child creation, verify email, retry required policy steps.
cases.expected: No child before verification/eligibility; valid recovery and safe expiry states.

cases.title: Cross-parent isolation
cases.method: With two parents and three child IDs, substitute IDs in every child read/write/report/export/select route.
cases.expected: No cross-parent data or mutations; consistent not-found/denial without existence leak.

cases.title: Concurrent child limit
cases.method: Submit simultaneous profile-create requests while parent already has two children.
cases.expected: At most one new active child commits; final count never exceeds three.

cases.title: Server parent gate
cases.method: Enter child mode; call parent endpoints directly, use history/back and reuse an expired gate.
cases.expected: Parent data/mutations denied; caches cleared; fresh reauthentication required.

cases.title: Auth-handler bypass
cases.method: Attempt library account/email/session management endpoints in child mode.
cases.expected: Reviewed allowlist enforced; no hidden-route privilege bypass.

cases.title: Consent and production eligibility
cases.method: Try unconfigured policy, fixture assurance in production and later family/child withdrawal.
cases.expected: Production fail-closed; writes stop immediately for withdrawn scope.

cases.title: Home and landing states
cases.method: Render landing and first-time/resumed/complete/no-content child home at 320 and 390 widths.
cases.expected: Eight benefits on landing; one clear child action; no fake scores or horizontal overflow.

cases.title: Catalog visibility
cases.method: Search/filter catalog containing draft, reviewed, published, retired and recalled versions.
cases.expected: Only entitled published results appear; no key/internal data leaks; useful empty state.

cases.title: Prerequisite graph
cases.method: Publish cyclic/broken curriculum and navigate locked/withdrawn prerequisites.
cases.expected: Invalid graph rejected; child has a valid path; parent override is audited without completion reward.

cases.title: Audio lifecycle
cases.method: Rapidly play/pause, switch routes/profiles during buffering, then trigger old ended event.
cases.expected: One audio controller; no stale playback or incorrect lesson advancement.

cases.title: Media failures
cases.method: Return 403/expired URL/503/bad MIME/range interruption and test replay.
cases.expected: Safe retry/unavailable messages; no microphone or synthetic recitation fallback.

cases.title: Canonical source integrity
cases.method: Alter a verse byte, swap source IDs, change verse metadata count or mismatch audio segment.
cases.expected: Automated checks block invalid mappings; human review evidence is required for publish.

cases.title: Arabic manual rendering
cases.method: Inspect approved marked Arabic at 320 px and 200% zoom in mobile Safari/Chrome and desktop browsers.
cases.expected: No clipping/reversal/unwanted translation; references and basmala follow approved edition.

cases.title: Practice versus memorization
cases.method: Complete all ayah units without a parent observation, then add/change a parent observation.
cases.expected: Practice reaches full fraction without automatic fluency claim; separate parent-labeled history exists.

cases.title: Question DTO leakage
cases.method: Inspect network JSON, DOM, cache and built bundle before answering.
cases.expected: No correct-option field or server key is shipped; options are valid public labels only.

cases.title: First answer and retries
cases.method: Submit wrong first answer, correct retry, duplicate IDs and option from another question/session.
cases.expected: First accuracy remains wrong; retries support practice; invalid memberships rejected.

cases.title: Quiz usability
cases.method: Complete five questions by keyboard/touch including error/retry/no answer state.
cases.expected: Visible feedback and navigation; no timer pressure; zero data not treated as failure.

cases.title: Game input parity
cases.method: Complete sound game with single taps and keyboard, never dragging.
cases.expected: Same outcome as optional drag; selected state not color-only; summary is separate from active board.

cases.title: Atomic event batches
cases.method: Send 20 valid events, one malformed/ineligible event within a batch, and same IDs after timeout.
cases.expected: All new valid batch events commit once; invalid batch changes none; replay returns stored result.

cases.title: Sequence conflicts
cases.method: Race heartbeat/answer, skip sequence and reuse ID with different payload.
cases.expected: Conflict errors expose safe last sequence; no silent reordering/double increments.

cases.title: Concurrent finish and stars
cases.method: Finish the same session in parallel and complete another version of the same logical lesson.
cases.expected: One completion result per session and one logical-lesson first star per child.

cases.title: Resume and replacement
cases.method: Pause/resume under 24h, expire session, replace via parent gate then send old events.
cases.expected: Accepted history preserved; expired/replaced sessions cannot write into new state.

cases.title: Active time estimation
cases.method: Send duplicate/large/negative heartbeats, background tab gaps and simultaneous sessions.
cases.expected: Bounded server-capped time only; no wall-clock idle or multi-tab double count.

cases.title: Reports and denominators
cases.method: Use mixed question counts, no answers, several local dates and a timezone change.
cases.expected: Weighted first-response accuracy and consistent local buckets; no divide-by-zero or fake totals.

cases.title: Comfort settings
cases.method: Set quiet/reduced-motion/goal settings then change child and reach goal.
cases.expected: Scope correct; requested lesson audio still works; break is gentle, not punitive.

cases.title: Staff roles and MFA
cases.method: Try every admin action as child, parent, wrong staff role and non-MFA staff session.
cases.expected: Least privilege and MFA enforced; no family impersonation or self-escalation.

cases.title: Publication separation
cases.method: Self-approve, modify approved payload, publish missing rights/audio and republish concurrently.
cases.expected: All invalid publication paths rejected; version hash/review relation remains immutable.

cases.title: Import/upload security
cases.method: Use oversized file, fake MIME, malformed JSON, arbitrary URL and redirect to private host.
cases.expected: Quarantine and allowlist checks stop delivery/fetch; errors do not leak credentials.

cases.title: Recall propagation
cases.method: Recall a version during active lesson, request fresh playback and start another session.
cases.expected: No new entitlement; active session stops on next check; history remains and safe alternative offered.

cases.title: Private parent reports
cases.method: Submit content report without gate and with another family’s object; inspect staff/audit output.
cases.expected: Only authorized reports accepted; notes private and excluded from ordinary logs.

cases.title: Private data export
cases.method: Export parent A, fetch job/link as B, expire link and inspect JSON fields.
cases.expected: Only A data; no secrets/keys; private expiring download; expected schema notes.

cases.title: Deletion lifecycle
cases.method: Delete profile/account, retry job and inspect DB/storage/caches; restore old backup.
cases.expected: Immediate revocation, safe repeated deletion and suppression after restore.

cases.title: Offline boundaries
cases.method: Cold offline open, drop network during loaded session, fill queue and reload.
cases.expected: Shell-only claim; unsaved progress clearly pending/lost on reload; no private service-worker cache.

cases.title: Responsive layouts
cases.method: Capture all primary child and representative parent/admin screens at 320/390/768/1024/1440.
cases.expected: Readable text, unobscured focus/buttons, real reflow; no whole-screen screenshot implementation.

cases.title: Accessibility review
cases.method: Keyboard, screen reader, contrast, 200% zoom, reduced motion, dialogs and chart table.
cases.expected: Manual issues resolved; scan results are not mislabeled as full accessibility certification.

cases.title: Secret/PII/third-party audit
cases.method: Inspect bundle, network calls, log samples, job payloads and image fixtures.
cases.expected: No secrets, child tracking, mic/camera permission, raw passwords or unnecessary personal data.

cases.title: HTTP security and limits
cases.method: Cross-origin mutation, CSRF attack, oversized bodies and multi-replica rate-limit attempts.
cases.expected: Requests blocked appropriately with generic errors and safe Retry-After behavior.

cases.title: Worker recovery
cases.method: Kill worker mid-export/import/delete, let lease expire and rerun.
cases.expected: Idempotent effects, bounded retries, safe final job status and no duplicate external side effects.

cases.title: Performance measurements
cases.method: Run fixed mobile network/device profile and 50-active-session load scenario.
cases.expected: Report actual timings/budgets, bottlenecks and untested conditions; no fabricated benchmark pass.

cases.title: Deploy and restore
cases.method: Fresh local setup, staging migrate/smoke, app rollback and isolated database restore.
cases.expected: Documented scripts work; actual recovery measured; production flags and deletion replay verified.

cases.title: Supervised pilot
cases.method: Run approved parent/child task protocol with qualified supervision and minimal data.
cases.expected: Record actual interventions and parent understanding; no unproven educational efficacy claim.

cases.title: Public launch gates
cases.method: Attempt release with missing source/legal/reviewer approval and with demo mode enabled.
cases.expected: Release blocked until named owners provide real evidence; agent cannot self-approve.
